name: Mandatory product standards and labelling
what: Make or sell goods that meet mandatory safety and information standards, labelling and trade measurement rules.

layers.who: Commonwealth (mandatory standards under the consumer law)
State electrical safety regulator (electrical product certification)

consistency_note: Consumer product safety standards and trade measurement are national; electrical product safety is regulated state by state.

basis.source: Administrative and support services industry (industry information)
basis.quote: Packaging must have correct product details and meet product labelling laws .

basis.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
basis.quote: increasingly accepting product standards adopted in other leading economies as 'deemed to comply'

Each state and territory has its own legislative scheme. Suppliers of electrical products, both within Australia and importers, must comply with the Electrical Equipment Safety System, the NSW system, various other state and territory requirements, and the Australian Consumer Law product safety regime.

issues.what: Suppliers of electrical products comply with a national scheme, the NSW scheme, other state requirements and the consumer law's product safety rules, all at once.

evidence.quote: Each state and territory has its own legislative scheme. Suppliers of electrical products, both within Australia and importers, must comply with the Electrical Equipment Safety System, the NSW system, various other state and territory requirements, and the Australian Consumer Law product safety regime.
There is no obvious benefit to Australians from this fragmented system.

issues.status_note: Treasurers agreed in November 2024 to a ministers' forum to oversee harmonised regulation (PC 2025).
